safety_limits: sanitized metadata and synthetic fixtures only
no GitHub mutation, runtime connection, SQL execution, backup, restore, deployment, or production operation
candidate/static evidence does not establish reachability, runtime behavior, authorization, recovery success, RPO, or RTO
all product/runtime/CI results remain NOT_RUN until an eligible fenced lease and required environments exist
title: Post-commit scoped invalidation and event-loss recovery fixtures

unmet: current event source and commit hook
screen freshness classes and polling bounds

contract.payload: stable resource/scope/version hints; no trusted business payload
fallbacks: bounded polling by reviewed freshness class
contract.legacy_writer_limit: WinForms may write without a Web event
contract.dispatch_boundary: event consumers treat every message as a hint and reauthorize/revalidate current scope and authoritative version before protected use

cases.synthetic_trigger: mutation transaction rolls back after an event candidate is created
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: outbox/post-commit ordering test tied to authoritative transaction outcome

cases.synthetic_trigger: client supplies a broader company/branch/storehouse group name
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: ignore client group request and derive groups server-side
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: authenticated scope mapping and adversarial subscription test

cases.synthetic_trigger: role or storehouse access is revoked while hub remains connected
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: invalidate membership and force authorized reread
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: permission revision fence and revoked-session test

cases.synthetic_trigger: event names include protected record IDs or state for an unauthorized listener
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: emit no sensitive metadata or existence signal
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: payload classification and cross-scope observation test

cases.synthetic_trigger: events are duplicated, reordered or a sequence gap is detected
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: deduplicate hints and re-fetch authoritative state
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: version/sequence contract and gap recovery test

cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: show degraded freshness and use bounded fallback
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: screen freshness policy and reconnect/revalidation test

cases.synthetic_trigger: WinForms changes SQL without traversing Web backend
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: discover change via authorized fallback without assuming push
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: disposable coexistence target and bounded refresh measurement

cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: bypass/rebuild from authoritative APIs; never restore permission from cache
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: cache isolation/failure test and server authorization assertion

cases.synthetic_trigger: background polling or SignalR traffic continues
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: server activity classification and expiry test

cases.synthetic_trigger: late event from old login/company arrives after context switch
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: fence it by current session/scope generation

cases.synthetic_trigger: team proposes a backplane or aggressive DB polling before measurement
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: keep topology decision open and polling bounded
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: connection/fan-out/latency measurements and approved capacity model

cases.synthetic_trigger: mutation response is ambiguous but invalidation arrives
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: do not declare success or retry from event alone
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: B5 outcome reconciliation using authoritative command/business identity

cases.synthetic_trigger: outbox row exists but business commit identity/version cannot be correlated
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: do not publish trusted freshness; quarantine/reconcile from authoritative business state
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: commit-correlated outbox identity and crash-window tests

cases.synthetic_trigger: event payload version is newer but belongs to a different scope generation
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: discard before cache/UI update and perform authorized reread
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: scope generation in subscription/cache key plus cross-scope test

cases.synthetic_trigger: client reconnects without a complete sequence replay window
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: mark gap and full-authoritative refresh for affected resources; never infer no changes
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: bounded replay/gap protocol or explicit full-refresh acceptance

cases.synthetic_trigger: backplane delivers duplicate notification after config/build generation changes
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: fence old generation and revalidate current resource contract before use
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: build/config/event generation and duplicate delivery test
